```{r}
# Function to run Cox models for each change variable (main analysis)
run_main_analysis <- function(change_var, data = df_final_analysis) {
  # Create formula
  formula_str <- paste0(
    "Surv(risk_time_art_10yrs, risk_art_flag_10yrs) ~ ",
    change_var,
    " + ",
    "cvd_event_between_tests + ",
    "age_baseline_test1 + ",
    "Sex + ",
    "cvd_art_before_HPA_flag + ",
    "EducationLevel + ",
    "income_pct_diff_from_median + ",
    "comorbidity + ",
    "year_test1 + ",
    "birth_cohort + ",
    "assigned_days_first_to_second"
  )

  # Fit model
  model <- coxph(
    as.formula(formula_str),
    data = data |> drop_na(all_of(change_var))
  )

  return(model)
}

# Run models for each change variable
model_exercise_main <- run_main_analysis("Exercise_change_first_to_second")
model_health_main <- run_main_analysis("Health_change_first_to_second")
model_bmi_main <- run_main_analysis("BMI_change_first_to_second")
model_vo2_main <- run_main_analysis("VO2_change_first_to_second")

# Extract results
results_main <- bind_rows(
  broom::tidy(model_exercise_main, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) |>
    filter(str_detect(term, "Exercise_change")) |>
    mutate(change_variable = "Exercise"),
  broom::tidy(model_health_main, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) |>
    filter(str_detect(term, "Health_change")) |>
    mutate(change_variable = "Health"),
  broom::tidy(model_bmi_main, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) |>
    filter(str_detect(term, "BMI_change")) |>
    mutate(change_variable = "BMI"),
  broom::tidy(model_vo2_main, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) |>
    filter(str_detect(term, "VO2_change")) |>
    mutate(change_variable = "VO2")
)

print(results_main)
```

```{r}
library(survival)
library(survminer)

# Create survival object
surv_obj <- Surv(
  time = df_final_analysis$risk_time_art_10yrs,
  event = df_final_analysis$risk_art_flag_10yrs
)

# Kaplan-Meier curves
fit <- survfit(surv_obj ~ BMI_change_first_to_second, data = df_final_analysis)
ggsurvplot(fit, data = df_final_analysis, risk.table = TRUE)

# 2. Cumulative incidence
df_final_analysis |>
  mutate(
    time_groups = cut(
      risk_time_art_10yrs,
      breaks = c(0, 1, 2, 5, 10),
      labels = c("0-1yr", "1-2yr", "2-5yr", "5-10yr")
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(BMI_change_first_to_second, time_groups) |>
  summarise(
    events = sum(risk_art_flag_10yrs),
    person_time = sum(risk_time_art_10yrs),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = time_groups, y = events, fill = BMI_change_first_to_second)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge")

# 3. Hazard over time periods
df_final_analysis |>
  mutate(time_period = cut(risk_time_art_10yrs, breaks = seq(0, 10, 1))) |>
  group_by(BMI_change_first_to_second, time_period) |>
  summarise(
    event_rate = sum(risk_art_flag_10yrs) / n() * 1000,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

# test data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(survival)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# Prepare data with standardized VO2 changes
analysis_data <- df_final_analysis |>
  mutate(
    years_between_tests = assigned_days_first_to_second / 365.25,
    VO2_change_per_year = VO2_change_continious_first_to_second /
      years_between_tests,
    BMI_change_per_year = BMI_change_continious_first_to_second /
      years_between_tests
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(VO2_change_per_year),
    !is.na(risk_time_art_10yrs),
    !is.na(risk_art_flag_10yrs)
  )

# Explore distribution first
summary(analysis_data$VO2_change_per_year)
quantile(
  analysis_data$VO2_change_per_year,
  probs = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Method 1: Data-driven quartiles
quartile_analysis <- analysis_data |>
  mutate(
    VO2_quartile = cut(
      VO2_change_per_year,
      breaks = quantile(
        VO2_change_per_year,
        c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      labels = c("Q1 (lowest)", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4 (highest)")
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(VO2_quartile) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    events = sum(risk_art_flag_10yrs),
    person_years = sum(risk_time_art_10yrs),
    incidence_rate_1000py = (events / person_years) * 1000,
    mean_VO2_change_py = mean(VO2_change_per_year),
    median_VO2_change_py = median(VO2_change_per_year),
    VO2_range = paste0(
      round(min(VO2_change_per_year), 1),
      " to ",
      round(max(VO2_change_per_year), 1)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    # Poisson exact CIs
    ir_lower_ci = ifelse(
      events == 0,
      0,
      (qchisq(0.025, 2 * events) / 2) / person_years * 1000
    ),
    ir_upper_ci = ifelse(
      events == 0,
      3.69 / person_years * 1000,
      (qchisq(0.975, 2 * (events + 1)) / 2) / person_years * 1000
    )
  )

print("=== Quartile-based Analysis ===")
print(quartile_analysis)

# Method 2: Clinically meaningful cut-points
# Common thresholds: >10% improvement, stable (±10%), >10% decline per year
clinical_analysis <- analysis_data |>
  mutate(
    VO2_clinical_change = case_when(
      VO2_change_per_year > 2.0 ~ "Major improvement (>2 ml/kg/min/year)",
      VO2_change_per_year > 0.5 ~ "Moderate improvement (0.5-2.0)",
      VO2_change_per_year >= -0.5 ~ "Stable (±0.5)",
      VO2_change_per_year >= -2.0 ~ "Moderate decline (-0.5 to -2.0)",
      TRUE ~ "Major decline (< -2.0 ml/kg/min/year)"
    ),
    VO2_clinical_change = factor(
      VO2_clinical_change,
      levels = c(
        "Major decline (< -2.0 ml/kg/min/year)",
        "Moderate decline (-0.5 to -2.0)",
        "Stable (±0.5)",
        "Moderate improvement (0.5-2.0)",
        "Major improvement (>2 ml/kg/min/year)"
      )
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(VO2_clinical_change) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    events = sum(risk_art_flag_10yrs),
    person_years = sum(risk_time_art_10yrs),
    incidence_rate_1000py = (events / person_years) * 1000,
    mean_VO2_change_py = mean(VO2_change_per_year),
    median_VO2_change_py = median(VO2_change_per_year),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    ir_lower_ci = ifelse(
      events == 0,
      0,
      (qchisq(0.025, 2 * events) / 2) / person_years * 1000
    ),
    ir_upper_ci = ifelse(
      events == 0,
      3.69 / person_years * 1000,
      (qchisq(0.975, 2 * (events + 1)) / 2) / person_years * 1000
    )
  )

print("=== Clinically-based Analysis ===")
print(clinical_analysis)
```

# Main Analysis: 10-year follow-up from first test
```{r}
# Define the change variables to analyze
change_vars <- c(
  "BMI_change_first_to_second",
  "VO2_change_first_to_second",
  "Exercise_change_first_to_second",
  "Health_change_first_to_second"
)

# Function to run Cox model for a specific change variable
run_change_analysis <- function(change_var, data = df_final_analysis) {
  cat("Analyzing:", change_var, "\n")

  # Create the data for this specific model
  model_data <- data |>
    drop_na(all_of(change_var)) |>
    group_by(id_cluster) |>
    filter(
      n() == 5,
      sum(treated == "HPA") == 1,
      sum(treated == "Control") == 4
    ) |>
    ungroup()

  cat("Sample size:", nrow(model_data), "observations\n")
  cat("Number of clusters:", length(unique(model_data$id_cluster)), "\n")

  # Build the formula dynamically
  formula_str <- paste(
    "Surv(risk_time_art_10yrs, risk_art_flag_10yrs) ~",
    change_var,
    "* treated +",
    "Age + comorbidity + assigned_days_first_to_second + birth_cohort"
  )

  # Add baseline adjustment based on change variable
  if (change_var == "BMI_change_first_to_second") {
    formula_str <- paste(formula_str, "+ BMI_cat")
  } else if (change_var == "VO2_change_first_to_second") {
    formula_str <- paste(formula_str, "+ vo2_cat")
  } else if (change_var == "Exercise_change_first_to_second") {
    formula_str <- paste(formula_str, "+ Exercise_cat")
  } else if (change_var == "Health_change_first_to_second") {
    formula_str <- paste(formula_str, "+ Health_cat")
  }

  cat("Formula:", formula_str, "\n")

  # Run the Cox model with error handling
  tryCatch(
    {
      model <- coxph(
        as.formula(formula_str),
        data = model_data
      )

      # Check convergence
      convergence_ok <- TRUE
      convergence_msg <- "OK"

      if (!is.null(model$info)) {
        if ("convergence" %in% names(model$info)) {
          if (model$info$convergence != 0) {
            convergence_ok <- FALSE
            convergence_msg <- paste("Failed with code", model$info$convergence)
          }
        }
      }

      # Also check for other convergence indicators
      if (any(is.na(model$coefficients))) {
        convergence_ok <- FALSE
        convergence_msg <- "NA coefficients detected"
      }

      cat("Convergence:", convergence_msg, "\n\n")

      # Return results
      return(list(
        model = model,
        data = model_data,
        change_var = change_var,
        n_obs = nrow(model_data),
        n_clusters = length(unique(model_data$id_cluster)),
        convergence_ok = convergence_ok,
        convergence_msg = convergence_msg
      ))
    },
    error = function(e) {
      cat("ERROR in model fitting:", conditionMessage(e), "\n\n")
      return(list(
        model = NULL,
        data = model_data,
        change_var = change_var,
        n_obs = nrow(model_data),
        n_clusters = length(unique(model_data$id_cluster)),
        convergence_ok = FALSE,
        convergence_msg = paste("Model fitting failed:", conditionMessage(e)),
        error = e
      ))
    }
  )
}

# Function to compute marginal effects for a model result
compute_marginal_effects <- function(model_result) {
  cat("Computing marginal effects for:", model_result$change_var, "\n")

  # Check if model exists and converged
  if (is.null(model_result$model)) {
    cat("Skipping - no valid model\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  if (!model_result$convergence_ok) {
    cat("Skipping - model did not converge properly\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Calculate marginal effects with error handling
  tryCatch(
    {
      margins <- model_result$model |>
        avg_comparisons(
          variables = "treated",
          by = model_result$change_var,
          type = "lp",
          transform = "exp"
        )

      return(margins)
    },
    error = function(e) {
      cat("ERROR in marginal effects:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
      return(NULL)
    }
  )
}

# Run analysis for all change variables
cat("=== RUNNING COX MODELS FOR ALL CHANGE VARIABLES ===\n\n")

model_results <- change_vars |>
  map(~ run_change_analysis(.x, df_final_analysis)) |>
  set_names(change_vars)

cat("=== COMPUTING MARGINAL EFFECTS FOR ALL MODELS ===\n\n")

marginal_results <- model_results |>
  map(compute_marginal_effects) |>
  set_names(change_vars)

# Display results
cat("=== RESULTS SUMMARY ===\n\n")

for (var in change_vars) {
  cat("### ", var, " ###\n")
  cat("Sample size:", model_results[[var]]$n_obs, "\n")
  cat("Clusters:", model_results[[var]]$n_clusters, "\n")
  cat("Convergence:", model_results[[var]]$convergence_msg, "\n")

  if (!is.null(marginal_results[[var]])) {
    print(marginal_results[[var]])
  } else {
    cat("No marginal effects available\n")
  }
  cat("\n")
}

# Combine successful results only
successful_results <- marginal_results[!sapply(marginal_results, is.null)]

if (length(successful_results) > 0) {
  combined_results <- successful_results |>
    imap_dfr(
      ~ {
        .x |>
          mutate(outcome_variable = .y) |>
          select(outcome_variable, everything())
      }
    )

  cat("=== COMBINED SUCCESSFUL RESULTS ===\n")
  print(combined_results)

  # Optional: Save results
  # write.csv(combined_results, "change_variable_marginal_effects.csv", row.names = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("No successful analyses to combine\n")
}

# Summary of model performance
cat("=== MODEL PERFORMANCE SUMMARY ===\n")
performance_summary <- model_results |>
  map_dfr(
    ~ {
      data.frame(
        variable = .x$change_var,
        n_obs = .x$n_obs,
        n_clusters = .x$n_clusters,
        convergence = .x$convergence_ok,
        message = .x$convergence_msg
      )
    }
  )

performance_summary
```

# plot

```{r}
library(scales)

# Prepare data for plotting
plot_data <- combined_results |>
  # Clean up variable names for better display
  mutate(
    # Extract the change category column name (it varies by outcome)
    change_category = case_when(
      outcome_variable == "BMI_change_first_to_second" ~
        BMI_change_first_to_second,
      outcome_variable == "VO2_change_first_to_second" ~
        VO2_change_first_to_second,
      outcome_variable == "Exercise_change_first_to_second" ~
        Exercise_change_first_to_second,
      outcome_variable == "Health_change_first_to_second" ~
        Health_change_first_to_second
    ),
    # Clean outcome variable names
    outcome_clean = case_when(
      outcome_variable == "BMI_change_first_to_second" ~ "BMI Change",
      outcome_variable == "VO2_change_first_to_second" ~ "VO2 Change",
      outcome_variable == "Exercise_change_first_to_second" ~ "Exercise Change",
      outcome_variable == "Health_change_first_to_second" ~
        "Perceived Health Change"
    ),
    # Ensure change categories are factors with proper order
    change_category = factor(
      change_category,
      levels = c("Decrease", "No change", "Increase")
    ),
    # Create significance indicator
    significant = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "Significant", "Not significant"),
    # Create effect size categories
    effect_size = case_when(
      estimate < 0.90 ~ "Strong protective",
      estimate < 0.95 ~ "Moderate protective",
      estimate > 1.10 ~ "Strong harmful",
      estimate > 1.05 ~ "Moderate harmful",
      TRUE ~ "No effect"
    )
  ) |>
  # Remove any missing change categories
  filter(!is.na(change_category))

# Create the main forest plot
forest_plot <- plot_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = change_category, y = estimate, color = outcome_clean)) +

  # Add horizontal reference line at HR = 1
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 1,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +

  # Add confidence intervals
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
    width = 0.3,
    size = 1,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)
  ) +

  # Add point estimates
  geom_point(
    size = 4,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)
  ) +

  # Facet by outcome type for clarity
  facet_wrap(~outcome_clean, scales = "free_x", ncol = 2) +

  # Customize scales
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Hazard Ratio (95% CI)\nHPA vs Control",
    trans = "log",
    breaks = c(0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0, 1.1, 1.2, 1.3),
    labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.1),
    limits = c(0.5, 1.3)
  ) +

  scale_x_discrete(name = "") +

  # Beautiful color palette
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Outcome",
    values = c(
      "BMI Change" = "#E31A1C",
      "VO2 Change" = "#1F78B4",
      "Exercise Change" = "#33A02C",
      "Perceived Health Change" = "#FF7F00"
    )
  ) +

  # Theme customization
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    legend.position = "none", # Remove legend since we have facets
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30"),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey50")
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "",
    subtitle = "Hazard ratios comparing HPA participants vs matched controls",
    caption = "Values < 1 indicate lower CVD risk for HPA group\nDashed line shows no effect (HR = 1)"
  )

# Print the forest plot
forest_plot
```
